content:
Returns a list of all permissions defined in your container.
Note: In the response, the permissions_granted  object lists all permissions granted to the
specified user group, and the permissions_available  object lists all permissions available but
not applied to the specified user group.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid> [0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{...
Show pattern
user_group_uuid
The UUID of the user group to list permissions for.
